title: The Small Interior
author: Ansel Joubert
blurb: Hazel Almeida, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
